notes.title: Announcing New Project
notes.content:
With Warhead out of early access, it will get updates, but slowly.

We are in the planning stages for Warhead Destined, which is using the same engine like Warhead but will be a dungeon crawler with randomized dungeons. We loved the idea of a dungeon crawler with the smart AI our enemies have, but we still have to see if the AI will work in a dungeon environment, we really hope it does! Or else we'll have to "wurk wurk" some more on it!.

It will have original pixel art, because we know how to draw pixel art better than vector art. And we really like pixel art in games too! We have hired an animator for a long term to do [i]some[/i] of the animating for our characters.

Here are some art that is planned to be animated and put into the new game.

notes.title: You should read this.
notes.content:
[h1]Our plan for the future of the game.[/h1]

The game is soon done. But we plan to add new playable characters to the game with their own stories as DLC. One of them is the Skull Knight, an undead risen from the dead by the mad drow sorcerers. He was used as a slave by the drow dynasty and had his will to live rekindled by Velkoz. However, Velkoz banished him out of his undead realm for not following orders and instead escaping the battlefield he fought on.

The Skull Knight is not an ordinary undead, but an undead with feelings, although somewhat less than the living.

Anyone that has the Skull Knight Edition DLC will get to play as the Skull Knight now, but not through his story as that will take some time. So consider it as a bonus with a new skin and gold for now. We can not promise that the Skull Knight story gets done, however.

We will soon go on vacation but we want to work on this when we get back.

Cheers,
Mibli.

notes.title: Devblog update
notes.content:
Hello. I'm currently dealing with press (twitch streamers), I'll try to develop the game further in the meantime even though after this "development hell" I went through with the bugs.

I've read topics about game developers playing their own game, if they enjoy it or not. I'm kind of like the developer that enjoys the game but likes to cheat, going through rooms in the engine and starting the game in different rooms.

Playing through the whole game before publishing it would take a lot of time away from a lot of things that could be done.

That is why I am curious what the streamers see when they play the game. I am mostly looking for if the position of the text changes when you switch rooms. Since I had this problem with the Keep room.

Best regards,
Mibli.

notes.title: Patch 0.3.0
notes.content:
[h1]Features[/h1]

Added shadows.
Added shaders.
Made loot drop.
Added whip weapon with it's own weapon technique. Whip weapons has close to medium range, bleeds and pushes enemies back.
Added waves to fight in Buzan Fields.

[h1]Maps[/h1]

Buzan Empire map is done.
Buzan Fields has been added.

[h1]Two new enemy types[/h1]

Bitefrog
Voidspawn Bitefrog

[h1]Campaign and Missions[/h1]

The story continues.
Working on Campaign Table and Mission Board.

[h1]Sounds[/h1]

NPCs greet you.
Footstep sounds for different environments.
Weapon sounds.
Enemy sounds.

[h1]Building[/h1]

Added an upgrade that you learn at Buzan Empire: Settlements. With Settlements you can pick where you want your building zones to be. But you can only pick once, so pick a good place!

[h1]Loot Table[/h1]

Added Entangled Whip, a common weapon.

[h1]Graphics[/h1]

Changed the tree resource graphics and it falls down when you chop it too much.
The player now looks more like an exile rather than a sinister being.

notes.title: What's in store for you in the next build.
notes.content:
[h1]Alpha 0.2.0 Future Patch Notes[/h1]

[h1]Sounds[/h1]

In the next upcoming build, sounds are addressed and taking seriously. I didn't want it to loop several times over again whenever you take footsteps. So that has been fixed. And people greet you with a "hello!".

[h1]Outdoor Buzan Empire[/h1]

The outdoor Buzan Empire map will be released, bringing with it for now interesting dialogues with NPCs. Can you remember what they said in the future? Good memory!

[h1]The blacksmith[/h1]

The blacksmith has been added, but without ores (and some gold coins!) come no crafting.

[h1]The indoor environment[/h1]

The indoor environment (church and castle) will be a tough way to tackle. I need to find good stock art for that or perhaps get lucky and have someone help me with the art for that.
